rag_test_cases.question: Why is my HbA1c high and what does 8.2% mean?
rag_test_cases.expected_answer: Your HbA1c is 8.2%, which is well above the target range of 4.0-5.6%. This indicates an estimated average blood sugar level of 189 mg/dL over the past 2 to 3 months, placing you in the uncontrolled Type 2 Diabetes range.
rag_test_cases.expected_evidence: HbA1c = 8.2 %, Estimated Avg Glucose = 189 mg/dL (Reference Range: 4.0 - 5.6 %)

rag_test_cases.question: Is my kidney health affected based on this blood work?
rag_test_cases.expected_answer: Yes, your kidney markers show signs of reduced function. Your Serum Creatinine is high at 1.38 mg/dL (normal: 0.59-1.04 mg/dL) and your eGFR is reduced to 51 mL/min/1.73m², which corresponds to Stage 3a Chronic Kidney Disease.
